channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Goran Dragic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Goran Dragic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Leandro Barbosa on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Leandro Barbosa:

“The hours to sleep is the most important in your body, you know? You got to have that eight hours, you have to. The other thing that helps me too,I don't drink. I been around with so many players that, you know, drink a lot, a lot. I think me and Goran, we be with some players. Goran Dragic: Listen, listen, in my defense, when I signed my first contract, I was 15. I was 15. So I was in a locker room with the grown-ass men, they were smoking, they were drinking. I was like, 'Whoa,' you know? That was part of life.”

Leandro Barbosa on Goran Dragic, Jun 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Anze Macek on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Anze Macek, the kinesiologist who has been working with Doncic for the past two years, gave some insight about the regime change the Slovenian wunderkind took this offseason.

“Shortly after the end of the season, he contacted me and said that he wanted to start fitness training immediately. Together with Goran Dragic, they worked for three weeks,”

Anze Macek on Goran Dragic, Aug 7, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Goran Dragic
item.description:
O'Neal said on The Big Shaqstrumental.

“When I arrived in Luka’s town some people picked me up, they drove me to a mansion that Luka had set up for me. I had the pizza there, I had the hookah there, I had the fruit, they escorted me to the show. “Luka said 'Shaq, ain’t nothing going to happen to you when you’re in my town, Mr. O’Nealovich' – that’s what they called me. So shoutout to Luka and Goran Dragic because their people really set it up for me.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Goran Dragic, Jul 22, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Rasho Nesterovic on Goran Dragic, Luka Doncic
item.description:
KZS' Secretary General and legendary Slovenian basketball player Raso Nesterovic didn't hide his frustration while talking to STA.

“We have one of the biggest stars in the basketball world on the team, who are ready to sacrifice their days off in the middle of summer, butwe have not yet received information on where, how, and by when we have to register and insure celebrities such as Luka Doncic and Goran Dragic,”

Rasho Nesterovic on Goran Dragic, Luka Doncic, Jun 9, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Steve Nash on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on Goran Dragic, who has COVID:

“He has symptoms. He doesn't feel well,but that's all I know.”

Steve Nash on Goran Dragic, Apr 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on facing Dragic:

“I think that he's happy where he's at now. Guys in that stage of their career, it's not uncommon. I like him as a person & I really like him as a player. Now we got to go compete against him. I'm sure he's gonna be motivated & hopefully our guys are too”

Nick Nurse on Goran Dragic, Feb 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic going to the Nets:

“I love Goran. He's a great fit anywhere... I'm happy for him. I want him to be happy.”

Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic, Feb 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Doncic on potential of Dragic playing for Dallas:

“I don't think we can say. We don't want to get fined by the NBA.”

Luka Doncic on Goran Dragic, Aug 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic:

“We’re always on FaceTime in the summer. And that was the hardest FaceTime I’ve ever had to do,”

Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic, Aug 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic sitting out the second night of back-to-back:

“This is just something we want to monitor and be smart about.”

Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic:

“I just wish he would dunk the ball one time. I'm waiting on that to happen. That's when I know the Dragon is back, when he gets a dunk.”

Jimmy Butler on Goran Dragic, Mar 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Miami potentially without Bam and Dragic:

“They have a deep team … they have an army of guys that play a great style of play that’s very difficult to guard and (always competes) defensively.”

Frank Vogel on Goran Dragic, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Marcus Smart on shutting down a red hot Goran Dragic last game:

“Games 1 & 2 he was very comfortable. Game 3 we came out and decided to make him very uncomfortable.”

Marcus Smart on Goran Dragic, Sep 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Goran Dragic
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Brogdon on Dragic (14p in 4th/21 of his 24 in 2nd half):

“He's a seasoned vet. Plays at his pace. He only takes shots he's comfortable with and down the stretch he knows how to win games. Can't let him control the pace of the game in the 4th quarter.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Goran Dragic, Aug 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Spoelstra on Dragic's calf strain:

“Some of it is to be expected. And we’re being probably, as we should be, very cautious with it. It’s muscle calf tightness, and we just want to make sure that’s taken care of.”

Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic, Mar 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Miami Heat coach Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic:

“He means everything to our team. In our eyes, he’s having an All-Star season. There’s a reason why we are where we are in the East, and he’s a big part of it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Goran Dragic, Jan 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Goran Dragic
item.description:
“We’ve just got to get back so (Dragic) can see a set defence and (we have to) keep him out of the lane,”

Cory Joseph on Goran Dragic, May 15, 2016. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Goran Dragic
item.description:
“Dragic, he’s got it down to a science of getting that off-arm out and kind of bouncing you a little bit. We gotta get adjusted to that, and the officials are not calling it,”

Dwane Casey on Goran Dragic, May 15, 2016. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Pat Riley on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Pat Riley on Goran Dragic:

“I feel confident this is where he wants to be. He's stated that.”

Pat Riley on Goran Dragic, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @PBPjasonlieser.

item.title: Pat Riley on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Riley on Dragic:

“If he doesn't sign, my ass will be in that [media] seat next year.”

Pat Riley on Goran Dragic, Apr 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Pat Riley on Goran Dragic
item.description:
“We are incredibly pleased to take another step in getting the Miami HEAT back to real championship prominence with the acquisition of Goran Dragic,”

Pat Riley on Goran Dragic, Feb 19, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Gerald Green, Goran Dragic
item.description:
“We have it set up now where we have a decent amount in the summer of 2015.We have some key free agents this summer in Goran Dragic and Gerald Green that we'd like to re-sign. We'll see how it goes. Right now our main focus is trying to win as many games as we can, trying to make the playoffs. If we do get there, win in the playoffs. After the season's over, we'll re-evaluate and see where we are in terms of the draft and free agency.”

Ryan McDonough on Gerald Green, Goran Dragic, Jan 29, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Goran Dragic
item.description:
Paul Coro:Coach Jeff Hornacek on #Suns Most Improved Player winner Goran Dragic:

“We use him as the example for all our players and they follow him.”

Jeff Hornacek on Goran Dragic, Apr 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Channing Frye on Goran Dragic
item.description:
David Hardisty:Channing Frye on Goran Dragic:

“What we're seeing now started in Houston. Unfortunately 4 the Rockets, they didn't make the right decision.”

Channing Frye on Goran Dragic, Apr 8, 2014. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Nick Young on Goran Dragic
item.description:
“It was a tough foul. What I’m mad about is it was one on five, I felt like, and if somebody would have gotten in the middle, it wouldn’t have escalated that much. “I feel bad for Dragic,”

Nick Young on Goran Dragic, Jan 16, 2014. Source: Valley of the Suns.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Marcin Gortat, Goran Dragic
item.description:
“I live in Phoenix. I watch the Suns religiously. And I’m very disappointed in their direction. “They’re not competitive. Even the really bad teams like Cleveland and Sacramento have players to build around. The Suns? Their best players are Goran Dragic and Marcin Gortat.”

Charles Barkley on Marcin Gortat, Goran Dragic, Feb 15, 2013. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Goran Dragic, Kendall Marshall
item.description:
“There was a lot of talk in the offseason about how I’m going to play and how I’m going to handle the whole situation without him. “I believe I’m an experienced player already. I’ve been in the league a few years by now, and I have other point guards. I have Goran Dragic and Kendall Marshall. I have great passers. I’m quite sure I’ll be fine.”

Marcin Gortat on Goran Dragic, Kendall Marshall, Oct 15, 2012. Source: Valley of the Suns.
